semantics.note: The normalization preserves both promised capabilities and the indefinite horizon. The descendants reference allows delay; it does not hedge eventual arrival or impose an antecedent.

contract.note: Readable search prose and dependable practical organizational assistance are fair ordinary readings. Allowing user direction without requiring complete autonomy is reasonable. The unspecified breadth and reliability of life organization make interpretation material.

evidence.note: Dated independent observations support the search-summary component, but summary length does not establish writing quality or factual reliability.
This company disclosure describes availability and advertised organizational capabilities. It does not establish dependable performance in repeated use.
The benchmark documents successes and inconsistent repetition on simulated everyday tasks. It limits claims of demonstrated dependability but cannot contradict eventual arrival.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports progress on search summaries but does not establish both capabilities under the fair plain reading. Agent disclosures and simulated evaluations do not demonstrate dependable life organization in repeated practical use. No early-resolution event is established, and current failures cannot refute a forecast without a deadline.
